note: Both sets suffer from excessive duplication of claims. Both sets contain factual errors where values are invented and quotes are modified to match (Set A claims 50% Nickel and 20,000 PSI; Set B claims 55% Titanium and 20,000 PSI). Set B is worse because it also modifies a quote for a correct value (changing 'mechanical force' to 'stress' for the 25,000 PSI claim) and has one additional incorrect composition claim compared to Set A. Set A preserves the correct 25,000 PSI claim with a faithful quote.
